variants.headline: Still in view: a new government takes shape
variants.sub: The colony has a newly formed government.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A new government has been formed in {colony}.

We welcome the contribution of {target}. Forming an administration is a legitimate achievement, and it deserves recognition without requiring us to pretend that every future difficulty has already been solved.
